sources_read: .qc-cache/hireops-lessons-2026-10-08-r3/rules/WebDev Rubrics QC.xlsx: Quality Checks row 26 (#25 judge_prompts_drive_the_browser, 'Every dimension prompt sends the judge into the live app via the browser tool - not scoring from source, memory, or a first-paint guess.') and Internal Quality Checks row 26 (same check); read in memory via zipfile/ElementTree (openpyxl not installed). xl/persons/person.xml is an empty personList; no threaded comments or cell notes exist in the package for this row.
.qc-cache/hireops-lessons-2026-10-08-r3/task/tests/*/*/judge.toml (all 5; mcp_servers blocks and all 56 criterion descriptions)
evidence: Skill reference (quality-checks.md:108-110): verify every prompt opens http://localhost:3000 and directs the judge to the Playwright MCP tool; defect = any prompt satisfiable by source, memory or first paint. (1) All five task prompts open the live app with the browser tool at line 1: 'Open http://localhost:3000 using Playwright.' (task/tests/gates/render/prompt.md:1, gates/constraints/prompt.md:1, scored/functional/prompt.md:1, scored/polish/prompt.md:1, scored/visual/prompt.md:1); app_context.md:4 'URL: http://localhost:3000'. (2) Every judge.toml wires the playwright MCP server (command playwright-mcp, --headless --isolated --executable-path=/usr/local/bin/chromium --no-sandbox), functional also wires the verifier restart server; tests/Dockerfile pins @playwright/mcp@0.0.79 and is byte-identical to the template. (3) Source/memory scoring is excluded in every prompt line 1: 'Use rendered UI and ordinary browser-observed product data only. Never inspect app source, bundles, filesystem, database files or implementation code. No shell or private-file probes. Discover routes and controls by intent, not assumed names.' Grading-only/checker-not-fixer block present in all five (line 7), satisfying Colderwater lesson 6. (4) First-paint guessing is excluded: render gate criterion requires a wrong-password refusal then a valid sign-in to a usable workspace; constraints gate and all three scored prompts require a UI add-candidate, reload, and an independent-context Observer readback before scoring (functional:11, polish:11, visual:11); visual prompt:14 requires reviewing Board, an open card, Noor's long conversation, Activity and the candidate view in an independent context, so visual Likert rows cannot be scored from a first paint; functional and polish 'Report every step' sections (functional:25, polish:22, visual:18) fail any skipped step (lesson 9). All 56 criteria (1 render, 1 constraints, 44 functional, 5 polish, 5 visual) describe browser actions/observations; grep for source/server.js/sqlite/curl/database-file/screenshot-only/memory wording in judge.toml returned nothing. (5) Colderwater lesson 13 (row-25 portal flag: no public internet address): grep of all prompts, judge.toml and app_context.md for http(s) URLs returns only http://localhost:3000 (6 hits, one per file); no outside site is needed for grading. (6) Tool feasibility of the named code runner: the prompts rely on browser_run_code_unsafe; MCP_RECIPE_COMPATIBILITY.json records actual installed dispatch of tool 'browser_run_code_unsafe' on 'Version 0.0.79' (raw RESULTS.json sha256 8aac3850...f855 re-verified), the same pinned version here; prompts also allow 'A supported separate-context tool is an alternative'. Counterexample attempts: a static mock or first-paint shell cannot pass any dimension because each requires a server-backed add plus independent-context readback; a judge cannot pass the visual rows from source because it must navigate five views; a conforming app with different routes/labels is not failed because prompts and app_context.md:37-38 require discovery by intent and forbid assumed routes/selectors. No defect found for this row.
run_note: No configured RewardKit/claude-code judge run exists for this candidate (raw-evidence-index.json scope: 'Full configured grading/workload ... are absent'; its entries are scripted golden Playwright observations, not a judge run). Whether the configured judge actually drives the browser as instructed is therefore unmeasured; this Pass is a source-level verdict on the prompt contents, which is what this row checks. Missing judge-run evidence is a separate runtime-record requirement in the pipeline, not waived here.
